name: Bridal Shower
tagline: Sweet stories, silly challenges and 'how well do you know the bride' guesses.

cards.text: Give {names} your best advice for their first year of marriage — keep it kind and keep it short.
What's the secret to a fair argument? Share yours with {name}.
Share one tradition from your own relationship or family that {names} should steal.
What's the best date idea that costs almost nothing? The bride gets to rate it.
Complete the sentence: "A happy home always has…"
Share the best thing to do on the morning of the wedding to stay calm.
What's one thing every newlywed should learn to cook together?
Give {name} a tip for remembering to enjoy the wedding day instead of rushing it.
Guess where {names} will go on their first anniversary. Closest answer (per the bride) wins.
Guess the first song {names} will dance to at their first family wedding as a married couple — genre only!
Who says "I love you" more often: {name} or their partner? The bride confirms.
Guess {name}'s dream honeymoon activity: beach, hiking, museums, food tour or something wild?
Guess who is the better cook in the relationship. The bride delivers the verdict.
Who's more likely to plan a surprise: {name} or their partner? Everyone votes, then the bride answers.
Guess what {name} ordered on their first date. Anyone within the right food group gets a point.
Guess the one household chore {name} will happily hand over forever.
Guess how many months until {names} adopt a pet — or will they never? Bride reveals the truth.
Guess {name}'s partner's most-used phrase. The bride judges who's closest.
Would you rather have a surprise wedding planned for you or plan a surprise wedding for someone else?
Would you rather slow dance to a song you hate or fast dance to a song you love, alone, in front of everyone?
Would you rather give a speech with no notes or read someone else's speech without seeing it first?
Would you rather honeymoon somewhere freezing or somewhere boiling hot?
Would you rather have a tiny wedding with 10 guests or a huge party with everyone you've ever met?
Would you rather write your own vows as a rhyming poem or sing them?
Would you rather have a wedding cake made of pancakes or a wedding meal made entirely of appetisers?
Would you rather always know what your partner is thinking or always know what gift they want?
Tell the room the moment you knew {name} was going to be a lifelong friend.
Share your favourite memory of {name} from before they met their partner.
When did you first hear about {name}'s partner? What did {name} say?
Describe {name} in three words, then tell a quick story that proves one of them.
Tell us about the best wedding you've ever been to — without naming whose it was.
What's the funniest thing that ever happened on a trip with {name}?
Share a time {name} gave you advice that turned out to be right.
What's the most romantic thing you've ever seen someone do? Keep it sweet!
You have 30 seconds to name as many things found at a wedding as you can. Go!
Invent a signature drink for the wedding (name + ingredients) in 20 seconds. Non-alcoholic versions welcome.
Recreate {name}'s reaction to the proposal. The bride scores your accuracy out of 10.
Give a 20-second best-person speech about the person on your left. Make it heartfelt.
Mime a wedding tradition. The first person to guess it picks the next player.
Come up with a couple nickname for {names} — combine their names in a new way.
Describe your dream first dance without using the words dance, song or music.
Name 10 things you'd pack for a honeymoon in 20 seconds.
On three, point at who will cry first at the wedding.
Point at the guest most likely to be first on the dance floor.
Who in the room gives the best advice? Point now — they read the next advice card.
Point at the person most likely to catch the bouquet (or dodge it).
Who would plan the best bachelorette weekend? Point on three.
Point at the guest most likely to give a surprise speech.
Who's the best dancer here? Point — they must show us one move.
Point at the person who knows {name} the longest. Is the room right?
Quick-fire: name a romantic movie genre, setting or cliché. Go round until someone blanks.
Quick-fire: name something old, new, borrowed or blue. Pause and you're out!
Quick-fire: name a kitchen gadget every newlywed needs. No repeats.
Quick-fire: say a word that describes {name}. Keep going until someone repeats.
Quick-fire: name a honeymoon destination, one per person. Last one standing wins.
Quick-fire: name a wedding tradition from anywhere in the world.
Raise a glass and finish the sentence: "To {name}, who always…"
Toast the partner who's lucky enough to marry {name}.
Make a one-line wish for {names}' first home together.
Toast the friendships in this room that will outlast every trend.
Give a toast to {name}'s family and the family they're about to gain.
What's one money habit or planning tip that has saved your sanity? Share it with {names}.
Guess the first big thing {names} will buy together. The bride says who's closest.
If {name}'s love story were a movie, what would the title be? Everyone pitches one.
